findings.finding: set_nets_to_route selects global-routing nets. Does not provide a detailed-router mutation whitelist.
detailed_route has no production net whitelist/freeze-preserving-NDR option. detailed_route_debug -net/-box controls debugging, not a certified scope restriction.
FIXED input wires are imported as fixed nets, cannot normally be ripped up and are skipped during output wire replacement. This offers a locking mechanism but changes the geometry classification.

Fixed net classification propagates to checker polygons. NDR spacing contributions are conditional on !rect->isFixed(). Therefore blanket FIXED conversion does not preserve the original active clock-NDR checking semantics; not accepted as equivalent enforcement.
Guide presence participates in routing eligibility but selective guide files are not a confirmed production preservation contract. Not used as an assumed lock.

missing_capability: Confirmed detailed-router two-net allowlist or immutable-wire lock retaining original NDR semantics and all unrelated geometry. Post-run comparison can reject excess changes but does not itself constrain the routing engine.
decision: No isolated routing candidate, command, or fallback prepared. Do not infer that physical repair is impossible; scope enforcement is not certified with the inspected interfaces.
